_note: Wild Rift item build-legality rules. mutexGroups: you may build AT MOST ONE item from each group. Since Patch 7.0, items sharing a named UNIQUE passive (or in a listed incompatible group) are HARD mutually-exclusive in-game — you cannot equip two. Groups below are (a) derived from shared 'UNIQUE - <NAME>' tags in data/items.json and (b) confirmed by the official Patch 7.0 notes. slots: a champion has 6 item slots, one of which is Boots (which holds one Enchantment).
